svg.aria-label: Sketch: a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket a few seconds off the pad at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, drawn after a CBS News photograph of the Crew-13 launch. The slender white rocket, topped by the Dragon capsule's rounded nose, climbs at centre above a bright exhaust column, while a billowing cloud of smoke rolls left across the pad deck. Four tall lattice lightning masts stand around the pad, two outer ones reaching the top of the frame, and the rectangular crew access tower stands to the right with its access arm swung away toward the rocket. The sky is overcast with light cloud strokes. No people in the scene.
